question: Why does transferring GPT-style tokenization intuitions to symbolic music often fail, and can token boundaries be derived by jointly optimizing predictive compression while preserving context-dependent musical relations?

key_findings.claim: Tokenization helps a bounded predictor when it exposes stable source regularities in an effective coordinate system, not merely when it shortens the serialized sequence or groups recurring events.
key_findings.evidence: The paper defines representation quality as the minimum expected predictive code length achievable by a bounded model family. In a matched control, reversible BPE shortened a REMI-like serialization by 71.07% but used 14.00% more predictive bits, whereas the coordinate-aware representation reduced code length by 25.15% relative to that REMI-like baseline.

key_findings.claim: Explicit musical-time coordinates progressively improve predictive compressibility when they remove serialization-dependent nesting without fixing higher-level musical semantics.
key_findings.evidence: Across three frozen seeds, replacing generic token position first with absolute onset, then multi-scale metric coordinates, then deterministic pairwise time relations reduced held-out bits per exact event monotonically from 3.166764 in arm A to 1.813576 in arm D, a 42.73% reduction; the direction was independently replicated on ComMU.

key_findings.claim: Reversible canonicalization can remove a nuisance coordinate while preserving exact reconstruction, but invertible decomposition alone is not guaranteed to help.
key_findings.evidence: On identically pitch-shifted scores, predicting canonical pitch and restoring the retained shift reduced test code length from 3.001370 to 1.813795 bits per event, 39.57%, with every seed agreeing. By contrast, decomposing pitch into categorical pitch class and register changed D by only +0.008324 bits per event and showed no gain.

key_findings.claim: Fixed pitch geometries can harm prediction because they encode relations whose meaning should remain context-dependent.
key_findings.evidence: Replacing learned categorical pitch-class identity with fixed chromatic or circle-of-fifths geometry increased held-out code length: arm E was 1.890478 versus D at 1.813576, and arm I was 2.042477 versus H at 1.821900. Most of the I-minus-H penalty came from pitch, +0.170510 bits per event.

key_findings.claim: The model uses ordered content-time context, and qualitative higher-order organization can emerge without chord, motif, voice, or part tokens.
key_findings.evidence: Removing left or right context raised code length by about 0.27 bits per event, while shuffling the same content raised it by 0.669 bits per event. An inspected continuation exhibited local recurrence, variation, chordal texture, and longer-range recurrence despite an unsegregated Note/REST stream with no structural labels.

method.core_idea: Define tokenization as coordinate construction with two boundaries: expose objective, reversible regularities at the Fact-Token boundary, and stop before context-dependent relations at the Token-State boundary.
method.mechanism: The representation decouples event content from onset, denests musical time into directed multi-scale unary and pairwise temporal coordinates, and optionally canonicalizes global pitch shift while retaining the shift for exact inversion. A small causal Transformer consumes coordinate-aware Note/REST events and predicts Type, Time, Pitch, and Duration by chain rule. Matched arms change only the representation interface, and predictive code length per original exact event compares coordinate construction, carrier coding, fixed relation projections, and context interventions.
assumptions: Predictive code length under a fixed bounded learner is an appropriate measure of representation effectiveness.
Onset, event type, pitch, and duration define the relevant observable scope; velocity, instruments, expression, and low-level MIDI structure are outside scope.
Musical-time transformations and global transposition canonicalization are deterministic and reversible within that scope.
Chord, motif, voice, phrase, and tonal-function identities depend on context and should not be fixed by the tokenizer.
Within-family matched budgets and frozen model envelopes isolate representation effects sufficiently.

techniques.role: Scores tokenizations by bits per original observable event under the same bounded predictor rather than sequence length or vocabulary size.
Separates event type, pitch, and duration from onset while leaving statistical dependence available to the model.
Exposes beat, bar, multi-bar phase, and signed temporal displacement directly instead of hiding them in serialization index.
Removes a known global transposition during prediction and restores it exactly during decoding.
Ablates fixed chromatic and circle-of-fifths geometries to detect premature representation-side commitment to contextual relations.
Compares reversible BPE sequence compaction with coordinate-aware coding using the same original-event denominator.
Removes or shuffles context to test whether predictions use ordered relations rather than context quantity alone.

evaluations.setting: Pop-K, 303,767 training rows, 1,024 validation and 1,024 sealed test rows; 16-layer width-64 causal Transformer; three preregistered seeds and 106,803,335 exact-event exposures.
evaluations.metric: Held-out predictive code length in bits per exact observable event.
evaluations.baseline: Generic-position arm A: 3.166764 +/- 0.007073, making D 42.73% lower.

evaluations.setting: Matched deterministic pitch-shift family on Pop-K.
evaluations.baseline: Predict shifted absolute pitch arm F: 3.001370 +/- 0.028535, a 39.57% reduction.

evaluations.setting: Matched pitch-interface family using D's temporal coordinates.
evaluations.metric: Held-out bits per exact event and paired factor change.
evaluations.result: Chromatic geometry E: 1.890478 +/- 0.012583; fifths geometry I: 2.042477 +/- 0.025104.
evaluations.baseline: Categorical pitch interfaces D: 1.813576 +/- 0.020722 and H: 1.821900 +/- 0.008827; I minus H adds 0.220577 bits, including 0.170510 on pitch.

evaluations.setting: REMI-like carrier J, reversible BPE carrier K, and coordinate-aware D, normalized by identical observable-event count.
evaluations.result: K was 71.07% shorter than J but used 14.00% more predictive bits; D used 25.15% fewer bits than J.

evaluations.setting: Fixed-target context interventions and qualitative continuation inspection.
evaluations.metric: Bits per event and visible musical organization.
evaluations.result: Removing either side of context added about 0.27 bits per event; shuffled content added 0.669 bits. One continuation showed recurrence, variation, and chordal texture without structural labels.
evaluations.baseline: Full ordered content-time context; qualitative source continuation for inspection only.

limitations: Author-stated: claims are limited to the tested representations, constrained model envelope, and evaluated symbolic-music setting.
Author-stated: predictive code length is model-relative, not a global coding optimum or a measure of musical quality.
Author-stated: the experiments do not establish explicit semantic decomposition inside the model or scaling beyond the tested setting.
Author-stated: the qualitative continuation is existence evidence, not a human evaluation of musical quality or structure.

Reviewer inference: performance-level attributes, instrumentation, and multi-track organization are excluded, so the proposed token boundary may change materially for expressive or orchestral generation.
Reviewer inference: three seeds and one small architecture leave open whether the ranking of coordinate interfaces survives large-model scaling.
failure_modes: A coordinate transformation can be invertible yet useless if it does not make conditional distributions easier for the chosen learner.
A fixed pitch geometry can erase alternative contextual interpretations even though the underlying pitch can still be reconstructed.
Aggressive combination coding can reduce token count while making each next-symbol distribution harder to predict.
A coordinate system tuned to one event scope can lose important expressive information when velocity, articulation, instruments, or performance timing become targets.
Qualitative emergence can be over-interpreted when recurring surface patterns are mistaken for robust learned harmony, voice, motif, or phrase structure.
reusable_insights: Evaluate representations in units of original facts and predictive bits, not tokens per sample.
Separate coordinate construction from carrier coding: grouping symbols cannot repair a coordinate system that hides the regularity of interest.
Expose deterministic reversible transformations to a bounded model, but retain nuisance coordinates needed for exact reconstruction outside the predictive state.
Do not bake a relation into tokens when its correct identity depends on surrounding context.
Use matched interventions that distinguish reparameterization, canonicalization, fixed geometry, and sequence compaction.
open_questions: Do the Effectiveness-Losslessness boundaries predict tokenizer quality for audio, video, molecules, robot trajectories, or scientific measurements?
How do coordinate-aware gains scale with model width, depth, context length, and corpus diversity?
Can internal probes verify that chord, motif, voice, and phrase variables emerge without confusing correlation with causal use?
How should expressive timing, dynamics, timbre, and multi-instrument roles be added without prematurely fixing contextual structure?
Can coordinate transformations be learned under explicit reversibility and relational-freedom constraints rather than designed manually?

competitive_landscape.title: Music Transformer
competitive_landscape.difference: Music Transformer adds efficient relative attention to an event sequence to model long-range structure; this paper focuses on the representation boundary itself and separates deterministic musical coordinates from contextual relations before attention.

competitive_landscape.title: Pop Music Transformer: Beat-based Modeling and Generation of Expressive Pop Piano Compositions
competitive_landscape.difference: Pop Music Transformer introduces REMI to encode metrical structure and improve generation; this paper turns that design intuition into a general predictive-code criterion and controls separately for time coordinates, carrier compaction, and fixed pitch geometry.

competitive_landscape.title: MuseTok: Symbolic Music Tokenization for Generation and Semantic Understanding
competitive_landscape.difference: MuseTok learns residual-quantized bar-level semantic codes and evaluates reconstruction, generation, and understanding; this paper deliberately avoids fixing bar-level semantic identities and asks which exact observable coordinates should remain available to contextual state formation.

competitive_landscape.title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps
competitive_landscape.difference: BEAT groups events into uniform musical-time steps and reports generation and efficiency gains; this paper keeps exact notes as carriers, exposes time through unary and pairwise coordinates, and uses bits per original event to show why temporal regularity and serialization compaction are different mechanisms.

novelty_assessment: Reviewer inference: earlier symbolic-music systems already use relative timing, beat/bar structure, compound events, or learned bar codes. The novel contribution is the two-boundary theory that distinguishes predictive coordinate construction from carrier coding and contextual abstraction, plus a controlled experiment suite showing that reversible canonicalization helps, fixed relational geometry hurts, and sequence shortening alone can worsen predictive compression. Its generality beyond the small symbolic-music setting is a hypothesis, not yet evidence.
reviewer_notes: The full text and experimental appendices were read. Percentages on page 8 were cross-checked against the absolute test values and paired decompositions in pages 13-14. Primary arXiv records were used for the four comparisons. Musical emergence is reported only as the authors' qualitative existence claim.
